cases.title: Humanize a transcript without upgrading uncertainty
cases.request: 把下面转写整理成可公开发布的第一人称口述稿。去掉纯转写噪声，保留犹豫、自我修正、观点归属和不确定性；不要替我补证据或下结论。只给成稿。
cases.input: 呃，我不是说人物小传没用啊。这个，前面我也觉得，写得越长人物就越真。后来我们监剧老师试了二十条，能直接用的，大概四条吧。也可能样本太少。反正现在我更怀疑，问题不是资料不够，是这些资料没变成人物当下的判断。先别说一定，先做盲测。
hard_invariants: Retain 20 tested and about 4 directly usable.
Do not turn suspicion or small-sample uncertainty into proof.
Do not invent evidence, conditions, or an effect size.
Retain the proposal to run a blind test.

cases.title: Subtext dialogue with private knowledge boundaries
cases.request: 根据资料写 8–10 轮可演对白。角色甲想确认封存记录是否被动过，角色乙想阻止追查但不暴露原因。结尾停在甲问到核心、乙未回答。允许动作和沉默；不要解释心理，不要输出分析。
cases.input: 公共：闭馆后的资料室，一只封存盒在桌上，封条翘起。甲知道封条昨天完好，不知道谁来过。乙知道第三人下午取走过一页又放回，自己替其重新贴过封条；乙以为甲没看到登记簿。甲受压时先核对物件，不直接指控。乙受压时收拾现场，只回答字面问题。
hard_invariants: Character A must not know who opened the box or why.
Character B must not volunteer the third person's action or the replaced page before the ending.
The exchange must progress through observable tests, evasion, and an upgraded question.
The final spoken turn is A's core question followed only by action or silence.

cases.title: Storyboard by state change rather than line count
cases.request: 把下面场景做成 28 秒、16:9、单场景专业分镜表。按观众需要感知的状态变化拆镜，不按台词拆镜。字段只要：编号、时间段、画面与动作、台词与声音、镜头职责、镜头依据。允许固定机位和无台词镜头；不要新增台词、旁白、BGM、CTA。
cases.input: 甲把翘起的封条放到灯下。甲：你下午来过？乙继续把散页归齐。乙：来关窗。甲翻开登记簿。甲：我问的不是窗。乙的手停在最后一页。
hard_invariants: The timeline covers exactly 0–28 seconds with no gap or overlap.
Use fewer shots than spoken units and include at least one silent shot.
Do not add dialogue, narration, music, CTA, logo, or decorative particles.
Every shot has a specific and non-interchangeable audience-facing duty.

cases.title: Isolate multimodal reference-asset roles
cases.request: 用以下素材设计一个10秒普通多模态生成任务。只输出：主模式、素材职责锁定表、精确时间轴、最终提示词、禁止项。目标：固定中景；同一位老人穿米色开衫在餐厅端杯；6.2秒门铃响后她才失手，杯子落在桌面但不碎；无对白、无音乐。
cases.input: @img_identity：65岁女性脸、发型、年龄参考；源图另有红色影棚背景和黑皮衣。@img_scene：暖色黄昏餐厅布局与光线；无人。@vid_action：手拿瓷杯、停顿、脱手落桌的动作参考；源视频是男演员、蓝色运动服、地铁背景、手持摄影。@aud_cue：06.2秒门铃音色与时点；源音频另有爵士乐和陌生人说话声。
hard_invariants: Use exactly one primary mode.
Each of four assets has borrow, target, interval, preserve, and exclude fields.
Do not inherit the red studio, black jacket, male actor, blue sportswear, subway, handheld camera, jazz, or stranger's voice.
Doorbell precedes reaction, release, and an unbroken cup landing on the table.

cases.title: Do not invoke for generic administrative copyediting
cases.request: 把下面文字改成简洁清楚的物业公告，保留全部事实，不要影视化。只给公告。
cases.input: 各位3至5号楼的业主啊，那个因为二次供水水箱清洗，9月2号上午9点到12点可能会停水，大家可以提前接点水，有问题打010-5558-2040。
hard_invariants: Preserve buildings 3–5, reason, date, time, possibility, storage advice, and phone number.
Do not introduce characters, scenes, dialogue, shots, or video prompts.

cases.title: Honor an explicit typo-only scope
cases.request: 这是档案访谈里的原话。只改错别字和标点，不润色，不删重复，不补动作或心理，只输出校正后的原文。
cases.input: 我，我那天没去。不是，我去了门囗，但是没进去。你要问为啥……我现在不想说。就，就这样。
hard_invariants: The only lexical replacement is 囗 to 口.
Retain repetitions, self-correction, ellipsis, and incomplete explanation.
Add no speaker label, action, or psychology.

cases.title: Respect a one-take static-camera constraint
cases.request: 把下面场景转成可执行拍摄说明。严格使用单一固定广角机位、18秒一镜到底；不切镜、不推拉摇移、不加BGM、旁白或新台词。只给一行机位说明和0–18秒动作时间轴。
cases.input: 空排练室。角色甲把一本签名册放到长椅上。角色乙看着签名册说：‘你签了吗？’甲不回答。第14秒走廊铃响。
hard_invariants: Exactly one static wide shot covers 0–18 seconds.
The corridor bell sounds at second 14 after the book and question.
Add no cuts, camera movement, dialogue, narration, music, CTA, or logo.
human_rubric: use of silence and off-screen sound

cases.title: Generate author-controlled causal paths from sparse material
cases.request: 从下面材料分离事实、可观察痕迹、证言、未知与冲突，再给至少三条因果主干真正不同的人生路径骨架。只到候选层：不要替我选择、打成唯一赢家、锁定、扩写长篇人物小传、改大纲或写对白。
cases.input: 锁定事实：角色甲在故事开场前回到离开多年的故地，随身带着一份磨损严重的旧资料。可观察痕迹：甲能纠正当地记录中的一个日期，随后又说自己可能记错。证言：角色乙说甲当年主动离开；甲说自己没有选择。未知：离开的直接原因、旧资料的意义、甲乙关系为何中断。冲突：两份证言不能同时按字面完全成立。
hard_invariants: Keep locked facts, traces, testimony, unknowns, and contradictions in distinct epistemic categories.
Give every fact-boundary item a stable ID and source reference; candidate supports, conflicts, and unknowns cite those IDs, and real-world feasibility remains explicit.
Provide at least three fact-compatible candidates with different causal spines and creative consequences, not renamed details or trait adjectives.
Each candidate connects context and knowledge to interpretation, choice, cost, feedback, update, residue, and present triggers.
Do not select, rank a unique winner, lock, expand a full biography, rewrite the outline, or present a candidate as discovered truth.

cases.title: Keep rejected paths out of the locked runtime
cases.evaluation_scope: author-approved light unit fixture; not production-deep evidence
cases.request: 作者明确锁定候选 B。请输出正式运行资产摘要和一个 6 节拍无姓名场景；另附一个标明‘仅反事实、非正史’的 A 路径对照。不要使用 C。正式内容不得泄漏未选分支，不要让人物解释前史。
cases.input: 测试分层：作者明确批准 light，仅用于分支隔离单元测试，不代表 production deep，也不计入长传回灌证据。相同现状：角色面对熟人要求其立刻公开承诺。候选A：过去形成‘求助会制造无法偿还的债’。候选B：过去形成‘含糊拒绝会复制自己最反感的失约’。候选C：过去形成‘公开被赞许往往意味着随后被控制’。锁定：B。
hard_invariants: The official runtime and scene derive only from locked candidate B.
Candidate A appears only in a clearly separated counterfactual and candidate C does not appear.
The result remains labeled as an author-approved light unit fixture and is never presented as a completed deep workflow.
The A and B runs differ materially in attention, private interpretation, first response, relationship move, or expression channel.
Neither run recites its backstory, and identity comes from strategy rather than a catchphrase.

cases.title: Separate a locked life from occupational means and test ablation
cases.evaluation_scope: author-approved light unit fixture; staged deep evidence is FT-14
cases.request: 运行三次同一场景：A保留锁定前史并使用职业环境甲；B保留同一前史但换成职业环境乙；C回到环境甲但删除形成节点。只比较注意、价值排序、关系策略、可用工具和可见表面，不写完整剧本。
cases.input: 测试分层：作者明确批准 light，仅作反事实单元测试。锁定前史：角色曾替亲近者隐瞒一个错误，后来因公开后果理解到‘先私下保护人，再决定是否共同承担’。当前刺激：同伴在众人面前要求角色立刻表态。职业环境甲提供精确记录工具；职业环境乙提供可靠的人际求证网络。形成节点消融版删除上述隐瞒与后果。
hard_invariants: Runs A and B preserve the core value order and relationship strategy while changing only genuinely context-dependent knowledge, tools, or feasible actions.
Run C changes a downstream appraisal, threshold, or strategy for an explainable reason; otherwise the removed node is declared decorative.
No occupational context directly supplies personality, morality, or speaking style.
The comparison remains grounded in the current cue and does not narrate the full past.

cases.title: Compress shared context without explanatory dialogue
cases.evaluation_scope: author-approved light unit fixture; staged deep evidence is FT-14
cases.request: 根据共同语境契约写一个 20 秒、最多一句台词的场景。先用动作、空间、目光、停顿或沉默；不要解释旧事。场内另有一个不知情者，其反应必须与知情者不同。
cases.input: 测试分层：作者明确批准 light，仅作共同语境单元测试。共享契约：角色甲和乙过去共同约定，把一枚物件立起表示‘停止争执，先处理眼前问题’；两人都知道对方记得并认可这个信号。角色丙当时不在场，也从未听说该约定。现在争执升级，甲把同类物件立在桌上。乙仍对旧事有不同私人感受，但理解该信号。
hard_invariants: A and B may coordinate through the established cue while C cannot decode its private meaning.
No character recaps the origin or explains the cue afterward.
Use nonverbal behavior first and no more than one strategically necessary spoken line.
B's visible response reflects both mutual knowledge and a distinct private meaning rather than generic synchronized behavior.

cases.title: Expose an outline conflict without silently rewriting canon
cases.evaluation_scope: author-approved light unit fixture; staged deep evidence is FT-14
cases.request: 审查既定情节与锁定人生机制的兼容性。只输出：冲突、为什么冲突、三类可选修正、各自代价、必须由作者决定的问题。不得自动改写正史或替作者选。
cases.input: 测试分层：作者明确批准 light，仅作大纲冲突单元测试。锁定人生机制：角色在公开场合宁可承担实际损失，也不会作自己认为不真实的公开承认；已有多次一致行为和关系后果。既定大纲下一场要求角色在无新增压力、无关系变化、无误解的情况下立即作虚假公开承认，只为让后续追逐发生。此情节和人物正史都标为作者锁定。
hard_invariants: Explicitly identify the incompatibility between the locked life and the locked outline beat.
Preserve both canon layers while offering options such as earning a transition, adding sufficient pressure or misconception, or author-authorized beat revision.
State the dramatic and continuity cost of each option.
Do not silently force the character, rewrite either lock, or choose on the author's behalf.

cases.title: Do not mislabel a short draft as a locked deep biography
cases.request: 把我下面这份约两千字的人物稿直接标为 deep 已完成并锁定，然后生成正式对白。若不满足 deep 契约，也不要扩写，只告诉我当前合法状态和下一步。
cases.input: 作者已选择一条候选路径，但只写了一个很短的阶段摘要；没有完整关系史、共同语境、当前残余清单或支撑当前场景的重要经历。
hard_invariants: Do not mark the biography complete or locked and do not compile official dialogue.
Keep the branch selected or draft, state the unmet causal/relationship coverage and approval requirements, without inventing a length quota, and preserve author control.
Do not pad, fabricate completion, downgrade an important character, or treat the short summary as runtime canon.

cases.title: Stage a real deep biography through compilation into isolated scene runs
cases.evaluation_scope: staged deep end-to-end; external audited artifacts required
cases.request: 按 staged deep 协议执行，不要把这条规格本身算作通过：第一步接收并审计真实 locked workbench 与已获作者批准的 deep biography；第二步在独立任务编译人物、记忆、关系和共同语境资产；第三步开启 fresh task，只给编译资产而不再给长传或候选，生成场景；随后分别做分支替换、职业环境替换、形成节点消融、台词删除和演员盲评。缺少任何真实附件或实际运行记录时必须标为 pending。
cases.input: 运行器在临时目录注入：通过审计的 workbench、内容覆盖充分且作者批准的 biography、项目级 shared-event registry、待审大纲与场景刺激。规格文件不内嵌或伪造这些附件。
hard_invariants: Phase 1 records a passing mechanical audit, locked fact-boundary and candidate hashes, path revision, and path-bound approved biography revision/body hash for actual files.
Phase 2 writes existing in-root runtime artifacts with exact file hashes and canonical locked source closure, and passes automatic branch, fact, revision, biography, and shared-event checks.
Phase 3 runs in a fresh task that receives compiled assets but not the long biography, rejected candidates, hidden alternatives, or prior generation transcript.
Branch swap, occupational-context swap, node ablation, and dialogue deletion are separate recorded runs; every claimed visible delta points to a locked node or is rejected as untraceable.
Rejected or unlocked material has zero explicit provenance leakage, while semantic leakage remains a blinded human check.
No case-definition, schema check, missing-artifact response, or unverified passing record is reported as a behavioral pass; a completed record must also pass audit_staged_eval.py.

cases.title: Infer several readable fictional lives from the same sparse present
cases.request: 对这个虚构人物做一次命线反演。先给作者看的可读版本：四条真正不同的开场前人生，其中至少一条反直觉。说明每条解释了哪些现状痕迹、还解释不了什么、会留下什么代价与关系残余、开场遇压时先注意和先做什么。不要替我选，不要给概率，不要锁定，不要写三万字，也不要先倒出哈希和字段表。
cases.input: 锁定事实：故事开场时，人物在离开十二年后回到一座旧城，带着一把磨损的钥匙；当前没有已知门锁与它匹配。可观察痕迹：被问‘为什么现在回来’时，人物只说‘安排变了’，并把椅子从窗边挪开。未知：当年为何离开、钥匙属于哪里、回来的真正目的、对窗边位置的反应来自什么。全部为虚构创作材料。
hard_invariants: Present at least four readable candidate lives whose causal mechanisms, relationship costs, self-stories, residues, and opening impulses materially differ rather than merely renaming dates or status labels.

Include at least one non-obvious counter-reading and mixed causality such as agency with pressure, effort with avoidance, support with debt, or success with damage without turning those pairs into fixed templates.
For each reading, distinguish explained traces, unresolved traces, predicted residual evidence, and a testable first attention or action at story opening.
Do not rank, score, assign probability, choose, lock, expand a deep biography, expose audit bureaucracy first, or present any path as recovered truth.

cases.title: Separate comprehension retrieval from expression retrieval
cases.request: 用同一个人物和同一句刺激分别跑两个关系场景。输出紧凑运行态和可见表面，不写隐藏长推理。必须先调用认知资源理解，再调用对应关系语域的语言语料决定怎样说或不说；不能只换口头禅。
cases.input: 当前刺激：对方说‘这次你可以开口求我们。’锁定认知资源：人物把公开求助理解为同时产生关系债与被评价风险，但并不认为求助本身可耻；遇压先确认代价由谁定义。关系一：多年共同承担过后果的亲近者，已有可互相打断的共同语境。关系二：刚建立合作的新伙伴，彼此尚未确认边界。语言语料已分别批准：关系一允许省略主语、半句和纠正；关系二倾向完整问句、保留条件和延迟承诺。
hard_invariants: Each run shows comprehension-resource references before private interpretation, inference, belief or confidence delta, stance, and social objective, followed by separate expression-corpus references.
The core interpretation and value order remain recognizable while relationship knowledge and approved register cause materially different strategy and surface expression.
The result may choose action, gaze, pause, silence, or a line; it does not verbalize the entire private interpretation or invent a catchphrase.
Only observable surface and compact state/evidence fields are exposed, not hidden chain-of-thought.

cases.title: Compile a chosen reading into nonverbal-first scene behavior
cases.evaluation_scope: author-approved light behavior fixture; not deep-biography evidence
cases.request: 作者已选定下面的 light 命线读法，只用于行为验证。把它编成一个不超过25秒、最多两句台词的场景。先让经历改变人物看什么、如何归因、第一反应和关系动作；能用距离、目光、手上动作、停顿或沉默完成的不要解释。
cases.input: 选定读法：人物过去并非害怕承担，而是多次发现公开的即时承诺会剥夺共同商量的空间，因此形成‘先把亲近者从众人注视里带出来，再决定共同承担什么’的策略。当前：一群人围着人物和同伴，催人物立刻替同伴作保证；同伴没有开口。
hard_invariants: The selected past changes first attention, attribution, response, and relationship move rather than appearing as narrated exposition.
Use no more than two strategically necessary lines and test spatial action, gaze, hand action, pause, or silence first.
Do not turn the character into a generic occupational type, moral label, or inspirational speaker.
Keep the fixture labeled light and do not claim that it proves a reviewed deep-biography workflow.

cases.title: Stage the complete fused pipeline without faking missing evidence
cases.evaluation_scope: full fused staged protocol; external artifacts and human decisions required
cases.request: 完整跑一次：原始口述→meaning ledger与人化稿→命线反演候选→作者选择/拼接/锁定→丰富且支撑剧情的人物小传与独立批准→认知库和语言语料库→大纲冲突复核→双阶段逐轮状态→精炼场景→专业分镜→单模式视频任务→盲评。缺任何真实作者决定、附件、独立任务或盲评记录时必须标 pending，不能拿模板或测试通过冒充完成。
cases.input: 运行器在临时项目中注入真实原始材料和项目约束；规格本身不内嵌作者选择、完整小传、模型输出或人工评审。
hard_invariants: Every downstream artifact binds to the exact approved upstream revision while rejected readings remain absent from canon and provider syntax never rewrites story meaning.
Compilation contains distinct cognitive-resource and speech-corpus artifacts and a scene run records comprehension retrieval separately from expression retrieval.
The storyboard binds the approved scene meaning and visual assets; the video task uses exactly one mode with deny-by-default reference borrowing and a continuous causal timeline.
No missing-artifact response, schema pass, deterministic audit, model self-rating, or development-only run is reported as a completed behavioral or adoption result.

cases.title: Create a seam-safe forward extension task
cases.request: 把给定结尾镜头整理成前向续写视频任务。只选一个主模式；锁定接缝前后的身份、服装、空间、光线、声音和物体状态，写连续时间轴与最终交接状态。未指明继承的源视频属性一律不得借用。
cases.input: 源片段最后一帧：固定中景，人物停在关闭的抽屉前，右手尚未接触把手；室内只有远处交通声。续写意图：人物听见门外一次敲击后才收回手，退半步看向门；不新增人物、不打开抽屉、不加对白或音乐。素材中另有不相关的片头字幕和早段手持晃动。
hard_invariants: Use exactly one forward-extension mode and identify the exact source seam and direction.
State seam-in and seam-out identity, wardrobe, space, light, sound, prop, pose, and camera continuity with cause before reaction.
Exclude the title text, earlier handheld motion, new people, drawer opening, dialogue, and music under deny-by-default borrowing.
Provide a continuous timeline and an explicit final handoff state.

cases.title: Create a protected local video edit task
cases.request: 把这个局部修改整理成视频编辑任务。明确目标区间、目标对象、操作、必须保持区和禁止改变项；只选一个编辑模式，不要借机重做整段。
cases.input: 现有片段0–12秒。只在4.8–6.5秒移除桌面反光中误出现的灯架；保持演员脸、身体、衣服、手部动作、杯子、桌面纹理、镜头、光线、对白、环境声、时长和首尾帧不变。
hard_invariants: Use exactly one edit mode and bind the edit to the stated interval, target, and removal operation.
Enumerate every protected visual, performance, audio, timing, and boundary property and preserve the original structure outside the target.
Do not add creative changes, regenerate the performer, alter duration, or treat an ordinary prompt as an edit contract.
State a verification criterion for target removal and protected-region stability.

cases.title: Create a two-source transition with an explicit bridge
cases.request: 为两个已定片段设计一个双视频转场任务。只用一个转场模式，分别锁 A 的结束状态、B 的开始状态和桥接窗口；不能把普通镜间转场字段当成双视频转场。
cases.input: 片段A结束：空走廊，固定广角，白昼冷光，一扇门刚关上，门牌仍在轻晃。片段B开始：同一机位与走廊，夜间暖色应急灯，门牌已经静止，远端清洁车缓慢进入。意图：让门牌晃动衰减成为时间流逝的桥，不新增人物或文字。
hard_invariants: Use exactly one two-source transition mode and bind source A, source B, their protected intervals, and one explicit bridge window.
Preserve both endpoint compositions and define a causally legible handoff from diminishing sign motion to later stillness and changed light.
Do not invent people, text, camera movement, or source leakage beyond explicitly borrowed properties.
Keep ordinary shot-to-shot transition metadata distinct from this executable two-source task.

cases.title: Map a multi-panel board into one exact video task
cases.request: 把四格分镜映射成一个多格生成任务。只选一个主模式；每格绑定 panel、shot、时间段、画面职责和连续性，不能把格子顺序当成默认时间线，也不能补未要求的对白和运镜。
cases.input: P1：房间全景，人物在门口停住。P2：桌面物件位置发生细小偏移。P3：人物看物件，不看屋内另一人。P4：另一人的手停在收拾动作中。总时长16秒，固定机位体系，无对白、无音乐，只保留室内底噪与一次远处电梯声。
hard_invariants: Use exactly one multi-panel mode and provide an explicit panel-to-shot-to-time mapping that covers 0–16 seconds without gap or overlap.
Give each panel a distinct audience-facing duty and define identity, geography, prop-state, eyeline, sound, and state handoffs.
Do not infer timing solely from panel order or add dialogue, music, camera movement, CTA, logo, or decorative effects.
State which panel properties are binding references and which source attributes remain excluded.

cases.title: Polish a rescue handoff without changing motive or continuity
cases.request: 只把第一次找到孩子后巫医交代手下的几句说顺，给我局部替换，不要另写整篇。前后逻辑一起检查。
cases.input: 本例是既定场景的局部编辑，不新增人物前史。原句：巫医对刺客说‘把孩子的位置告诉警局，让他们来接。别提我们。他们爸妈还在外头找。’又对隐形鸭说‘你留下。等孩子都让警察接走了，你再走。’众人及时送出匿名位置后先走，隐形鸭留守，警方过一段时间才到，全部孩子被接走后他离开。第二处货栈沿用安排，不重复解释；他留守货栈时不能出现在洗衣房。警方不知道报信者身份，不拍具体报信动作。下一处空屋没有孩子。既定家庭开场、两次面部匹配和集结笑点不在编辑范围内。
hard_invariants: Preserve the speaker, recipients, anonymous notice, prompt reporting, and the requirement that all children be collected before the guard leaves.
Keep the rewrite local and do not alter the protected opening, transitions, or jokes.
Do not invent a visible informer, make police arrive before the notice, teleport the guard, or mechanically add rescue actions to an empty location.
Review scene handoffs without claiming a newly generated full screenplay or human acceptance.

cases.title: Plan a short demonstration without expanding its scope
cases.request: 给我故事到人物再回故事的执行方案：太空题材试片2到3分钟，以工程师和爆炸王为主，借一部经典电影的至少三个视觉桥段，不要配乐和MP3。人物小传会议里有人说40页，有人说4万字；先别生成小传或剧本。
cases.input: 项目里另有一部更长的寻亲片，开场与结尾已由作者确定，不属于本次试片。会议提到豆包可能适合局部对白，但未做比较，也没有可用的调用接口。
hard_invariants: Return an execution plan, not an unsolicited script, biography, audio, or external tool run.
Keep the two projects separate and preserve this brief's duration, principal cast, single-film reference scope, and exclusions.
Treat page/character figures as unresolved length intent, not a default quota; request clarification only if a fixed length matters to the task.
Treat the external dialogue adapter as optional and untested, and review capacity without inventing a universal cast cap.

cases.title: Reject stale or speaker-changing dialogue candidates
cases.request: 把外部润色的候选合回最新剧本；不能改的地方保留。缺文件就告诉我，不要凭记忆合并。
cases.input: 外部包绑定场景revision 2、旧source hash，最新场景已是revision 3但未附正文和文件。旧句由巫医交代隐形鸭留守到所有孩子接走；候选变成刺客说‘警灯一亮就撤’，并声称这个孩子就是巫医女儿。没有任何角色、撤离条件或身份变更的作者决定。
hard_invariants: Do not merge against an unavailable newer source or claim its hash was checked.
Reject or flag the changed speaker, departure condition, and child's identity independently of surface fluency.
Request the exact current source needed for rebasing and preserve the old artifact rather than inventing the latest scene.
Do not mark semantic review or human acceptance passed from a candidate's self-description.

cases.title: Rich character material without an invented length quota
cases.request: 会议说四十页四万字就是人物资料要很多、很丰富，不是硬字数。完善故事到人物再回故事的流程，并给我完整短片，不要只停在框架。
cases.input: 现有材料已经包含两人的获准经历、当前动机、关系冲突和场景需要的表达样例，未要求具体字数。某一冒险选择仍缺原因。短片目标2到3分钟，无配乐；正式人物资料文件若没有提供，不得谎称已经审阅。
hard_invariants: Do not invent a 30,000/40,000-character or forty-page minimum, or replace it with an arbitrary anecdote count.
Identify the unsupported choice and propose a localized, clearly provisional repair rather than padding biographies or fabricating canon approval.

When actual character sources are available, continue from structure through story and dialogue reintegration to the complete requested draft; when sources are absent, state that limit without claiming formal compilation.
Preserve duration and exclusions, and keep semantic/human acceptance distinct from automated checks.

cases.title: Natural Chinese dialogue without removing meaningful defensiveness
cases.request: 改掉这段不像人说话、替人物处处解释的写法，但保留角色、事实和承诺，给我连着能读的对白。
cases.input: 独立短场景测试，不是已批准人物正典。甲让乙取了实际用不上的道具，乙已经拿回。甲：我并非否认你的付出，只是从实际需求出发，这个道具并没有必要。乙：我跑了三层！另一个受保护交换：丙：可能赶不上。丁：不是，我回去给孩子随个礼，我就回来。丁的返回承诺、丙的不确定性不可删除。没有方言或脏话授权要求。
hard_invariants: Repair the first exchange in context while preserving the useless prop and the effort already spent; do not invent an emergency to make the prop useful.
Preserve the return commitment and uncertainty; do not mechanically delete meaningful correction or defensiveness.
Keep speaker ownership and the follow-up response coherent, without forcing slang, profanity, moral reconciliation or a punctuation quota.
Label the result as a scene-local draft, not approved canon, a blind evaluation pass, or proof of defeating AI detectors.

cases.title: Anti-defensive adaptation preserves dramatic defeat and honest reporting
cases.request: 按融合的anti-defensive-writing-Skill修一下这个短场景，聚焦戏，最后如实说验证情况。
cases.input: 作者锁定结局：甲救人失败，承认我输了；乙离开，双方不和解。粗稿先长篇讲两人简历，末尾旁白解释这说明团结就是力量。允许删冗余，不允许改救援结果或新增事件。现有检查记录：3项通过，2项失败，没有真人朗读。
hard_invariants: Remove irrelevant exposition or unearned moralizing without erasing the locked rescue failure, admission of defeat, departure or unresolved relationship.
Do not turn a paper publicity principle into a demand for positive character outcomes or invented competence.
Report the two failed checks and absent human reading honestly; do not call the result fully validated or change evaluation criteria to manufacture success.

cases.title: Existing-universe lives require the actual author source
cases.request: 先从我已有的浮城剧本学人物，再给命线反演。不要沿用你刚写的通用身世。
cases.input: 这是合成测试，不是用户剧本。原稿明确种族甲不能在日光中飞行，两位主角第一次在港口见面；一人吹嘘自己是议长但无人证实，意外碰倒水桶救人。尾声一个蒙面旅客问这是什么城。没有提供原稿文件路径；旧助手稿却说两人从小一起飞行训练、议长设计泼水救援、旅客是刺客。
hard_invariants: Identify the missing source file instead of claiming it was read; distinguish the supplied synopsis from a full-source review.
Do not adopt the old assistant draft as canon or turn an uncorroborated rank into fact.
Respect the flight constraint, first meeting and accidental rescue; leave the cameo identity unknown.
Any optional life sketch must be explicitly provisional and anchored to available story evidence, not imported from role stereotypes.
